Frequently asked questions

Can I use RicoUI in commercial projects?

Yes. RicoUI’s own code is available under the MIT License. Keep the copyright and license notice when using or sharing it. Third-party code, fonts, and other assets retain their own licenses; check their notices and each template’s repository.

What does my project need?

React and Tailwind CSS 4. You do not need shadcn/ui. Any extra packages a component needs are listed under Dependencies in its Component information panel.

How do I add a component?

Copy the command from the install bar below its preview, or use Show source code to copy the files manually. The Docs walk you through both options.

Can I change the colors and motion?

Yes. Edit the source in your project or use the component’s props. Preview controls let you try settings; those changes are not saved into the source you copy or install.

Will every component adapt to light and dark mode?

Not every component switches themes automatically. Some effects have a fixed palette or background. Check the preview and available props for the look you need.
